description_en: Queries the attack type details of a volumetric attack
description_zh: 查询某次流量型攻击的攻击类型详情
name: DescribeDDosEventAttackType

parameters.help_en:
The type of the attack event to query. Valid values:

defense: volumetric attack scrubbing events.
blackhole: volumetric attack blackhole filtering events
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的攻击事件的类型。取值：

defense：表示流量型攻击清洗事件。
blackhole：表示流量型攻击黑洞事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The start timestamp of the event to query. Unit: seconds.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188604.html to query the start time of all events
parameters.help_zh:
要查询事件的开始时间戳，单位：秒。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188604.html查询所有事件的开始时间信息
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The attacked IP Address of Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
parameters.name: ip
